profile_text.body:
Netflix Inc is a publicly traded company headquartered in Los Gatos, California, trading under the ticker NFLX. According to its own site, Netflix describes itself as one of the world's leading entertainment services, offering TV series, films, games and live programming across a wide variety of genres and languages. The site states that members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time. It also states that Netflix has over 260 million paid memberships in over 190 countries.

The harvested material does not identify any specific AI products or AI initiatives from the company. No products are tracked for Netflix in the data, and no MCP servers are listed.

The held facts record no lawsuits involving the company. The company's law exposure is recorded in California, with a count of 281. Netflix is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001065280.
